messages:
elaine: Postmortem follow-up: DR/regional failover action items from last week's outage. I've created consolidated list + owners. Need game-day schedule. TL;DR: focus on multi-region routing, backups validation, restore runbooks.

sam: Thanks. can we set owners for the routing playbook? @raj volunteered in postmortem but need ETA.

raj: I can own routing policy + test harness. ETA end of next week (2024-05-28). Will add a PR with config and test cases.

maria: I'll take backups validation (s3 cross-region replication + periodic restore smoke tests). propose weekly restore drills starting June 3. :calendar: 

sre-lead: Agree. For SLA-sensitive customers we need documented RTO/RPO per tier. I'll update the runbook template. Also propose a 4-hour 'game day' on Jun 10.

elaine: Action items summary: 1) multi-region routing policy (owner: raj, due: 2024-05-28) 2) backup & restore drills (owner: maria, due: first drill 2024-06-03) 3) restore runbook rewrite (owner: sre-lead, due: 2024-05-24) 4) DR monitoring (owner: sam, due: 2024-05-20). Will track in the incident board.

sam: I'll add cards to the 'incidents/dr-postmortem' board and set weekly check-ins. Also, can we add synthetic traffic for failover testing? small script:
```bash
# run from each region
python tools/failover_tester.py --profile prod --duration 5m
```

raj: Will include the routing config sample in PR:
```yaml
routing:
  primary: us-west-2
  failover:
    - eu-west-1
    - ap-southeast-1
  health_check: /v1/health
  max_latency_ms: 300
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: schedule created for maintenance window Jun 10 02:00-06:00 UTC. /cc @everyone

maria: One risk: snapshot consistency across regions during live traffic. We'll add a pre-freeze flush step to runbook.

sre-lead: Noted. Raj and Maria — coordinate on ordering: snapshot flush then routing switchover tests. Let's run a tabletop next Tue.

elaine: Perfect. I'll put a summary + owners into the postmortem doc and ping execs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
